_comment: Overrides for scripts/appimage-notices.py, which adds the notices and source pointers of the
system libraries Tauri's linuxdeploy step copies into the AppImage. Paths in 'own' and 'files'
are AppDir-relative fnmatch patterns; license_files are relative to this file. Every other
bundled file must belong to a package installed on the build runner, or the step fails.
Text provenance (SHA-256): type2-runtime-LICENSE.txt AppImage/type2-runtime LICENSE at 75849dce7cc37e4319b633df1f116ca895c71a12 (aa154fc9...);
libfuse-LGPL2.txt libfuse LGPL2.txt at fuse-3.15.0 (dc626520...); squashfuse-LICENSE.txt vasi/squashfuse LICENSE at 0.5.2 (9e909cc8...);
zstd-LICENSE.txt facebook/zstd LICENSE at v1.5.6 (70552664...); zlib-LICENSE.txt madler/zlib LICENSE at v1.3.2 (e32ff4e0...);
musl-COPYRIGHT.txt musl COPYRIGHT at v1.2.5 (f9bc4423...); AppImageKit-LICENSE.txt AppImage/AppImageKit LICENSE at

own.reason: Copywraith's own executable; the Rust crates, Rust standard library, npm packages and fonts it embeds are listed in usr/share/doc/copywraith/Third-Party-Notices.txt and Rust-Licenses.html
Copywraith's own desktop entry, written by the Tauri bundler
Copywraith's own icon, copied to the AppDir root by linuxdeploy
Written by linuxdeploy at build time: sources apprun-hooks/ and starts AppRun.wrapped
Generated at build time by linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk from the bundled gdk-pixbuf loaders; lists their paths only
Generated at build time by linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk (gio-querymodules) from the bundled GIO modules; lists their names only
Generated at build time by linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk from the bundled GTK input-method modules; lists their paths only
Compiled at build time by linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk from the bundled GSettings schema files, which are attributed to their packages

files.reason: The Tauri bundler downloads AppImageKit's prebuilt AppRun (tauri-apps/binary-releases tag apprun-old) and linuxdeploy keeps it as AppRun.wrapped
Hook script written by the linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk copy embedded in the Tauri bundler

extra.name: AppImage type2-runtime
extra.license: MIT AND LGPL-2.1-only AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND Zlib
sources: Statically links libfuse {libfuse_version} (LGPL-2.1, patched by patches/libfuse in the runtime source): https://github.com/libfuse/libfuse/releases/tag/fuse-{libfuse_version}
Statically links musl (MIT), zstd {zstd_version} (BSD-3-Clause) and zlib {zlib_version} (Zlib) from the Alpine Linux release named in the runtime source's scripts/chroot/chroot_build.sh
extra.reason: The runtime is the AppImage's ELF header, outside the squashfs, so no host package owns it. The texts match runtime 75849dc, which the v0.3.1 AppImage embeds; the runtime commit pins the exact sources.

extra.name: AppImageKit AppRun
extra.reason: AppRun-x86_64 from https://github.com/tauri-apps/binary-releases/releases/tag/apprun-old, a mirror of AppImageKit's continuous release; AppImageKit's LICENSE last changed in c7289b6e

extra.name: linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk (Tauri fork)
extra.reason: The hook script comes from the plugin copy in the Tauri bundler, forked from linuxdeploy/linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk; LICENSE.txt is unchanged since 2019
